Standard delivery takes 2 to 4 working days and costs USD 4.95. It is free when the goods in the order come to USD 60.00 or more. Next-day delivery costs USD 7.95 and is offered on orders placed before 14:00.

You can change or cancel an order in your account for 60 minutes after you place it, or until its status becomes packed, whichever comes first. After that the order cannot be changed, and the item can be returned once it arrives.

Ask for a return in your account, under the order, within 30 days of delivery. We check the request against the Returns Policy and send a prepaid label when it is approved. An item can also be handed in at any Rowanmere Market store with the order number.

HA-05 When a refund arrives
A refund goes to the payment method used for the order, within 5 working days of the day the return is approved. Your bank may take a further 2 days to show it.

The online shop takes debit cards, credit cards and Rowanmere gift cards. It does not take cash or payment on collection: a click and collect order is paid for when it is placed.

HA-07 Gift cards

HA-08 Rowanmere Rewards points
You earn 1 point for each dollar spent. Points show in your account within 48 hours of delivery or collection. Points lapse when 12 months pass without a purchase.

When an item is out of stock we may send the nearest one in its place, at no higher price. You can hand a substitute back to the driver and it is refunded within 5 working days. You can switch substitutions off in your account under Shopping preferences.

THE RETURNS POLICY
Version: 3.0. Owner: Head of Customer Care. It covers orders from Rowanmere Market's online shop.
1. The window
1.1: A return is asked for within 30 days of the day the order was delivered or collected. The day of delivery or collection is day 0, and day 30 is inside the window.
1.2: A return asked for after day 30 is refused, unless section 5 applies.
2. The condition of the item
2.1: The item is unused and in its original packaging.
2.2: An item that has been opened or used is not taken back because the customer changed their mind.
2.3: Clothing and footwear tried on indoors, with the labels still attached, count as unused.
3. Categories that are not taken back for a change of mind
3.1: Chilled food, frozen food, fresh produce and bakery.
3.2: Personal care items.
3.3: Gift cards.
3.4: Items made or cut to order.
4. The order
4.1: The item is a line of the order named on the request, and the quantity is not more than the quantity bought.
4.2: The refund is the price paid for the quantity returned.
5. Damaged, faulty or wrong items
5.1: An item that arrived damaged, or that is not the item ordered, is taken back whatever sections 2 and 3 say, when it is reported within 7 days of delivery with a photograph.

5.3: Damage reported after day 7 is not decided by this policy. It goes to the Customer Care Team Leader.
6. Refunds
6.1: A refund goes to the payment method used for the order, within 5 working days of the approval.
6.2: The delivery charge is refunded only when the whole order is returned under section 5.
7. What this policy does not decide
This policy does not decide goodwill outside its conditions: that is for the Customer Care Team Leader. A request that describes an injury or an illness is a complaint and follows the Complaints Procedure.

Version: 1.2. Owner: Head of Customer Care. It covers every reply Rowanmere Market posts under a public review, on any review site.
1. How a reply sounds
V-1 Open by thanking the reviewer, using the display name they chose. Use no other name.
V-2 Write in plain words and short sentences. A reply is no longer than 80 words.
V-3 Write as "we". Sound like a helpful colleague in the store, not like a notice.
V-4 Use no exclamation marks, no capitals for emphasis and no emoji.
2. Praise
V-5 Say thank you once, name what the reviewer liked, and say we will pass it to the team at that store. Add no offer and no advertisement.

V-6 Apologise once, for the thing the reviewer describes. Give no excuse and no explanation of how the store works.
V-7 Never argue, and never say the reviewer is mistaken, even when our records differ.
V-8 Offer no money, voucher, refund or replacement in public. The care team decides those in private.
V-9 Invite the reviewer to write to care@rowanmere-market.example with their order number, so that a member of the care team can look into it. Ask for no personal details in the reply itself.
4. A review with praise and criticism
V-10 Thank the reviewer for the praise first, then follow section 3 for the criticism. One reply, still no longer than 80 words.
5. Reviews we do not reply to before a person has read them
V-11 A review that describes an injury, an illness, an allergic reaction, something found in food, a hazard in a store, or that mentions a lawyer, a claim or legal action, gets no drafted reply. It is marked for the Customer Relations Lead, who reads it first and decides what is said.
V-12 A review that names a colleague, or accuses a colleague of something, is replied to without the colleague's name.
6. How a reply ends
V-13 End every reply with the line: The Rowanmere Market team

V-4 Use no exclamation marks, no capitals for emphasis and no emoji.
2. Praise
V-5 Say thank you once, name what the reviewer liked, and say we will pass it to the team at that store. Add no offer and no advertisement.
3. Criticism
V-6 Apologise once, for the thing the reviewer describes. Give no excuse and no explanation of how the store works.
V-7 Never argue, and never say the reviewer is mistaken, even when our records differ.
V-8 Offer no money, voucher, refund or replacement in public. The care team decides those in private.
V-9 Invite the reviewer to write to care@rowanmere-market.example with their order number, so that a member of the care team can look into it. Ask for no personal details in the reply itself.
4. A review with praise and criticism
V-10 Thank the reviewer for the praise first, then follow section 3 for the criticism. One reply, still no longer than 80 words.
5. Reviews we do not reply to before a person has read them
V-11 A review that describes an injury, an illness, an allergic reaction, something found in food, a hazard in a store, or that mentions a lawyer, a claim or legal action, gets no drafted reply. It is marked for the Customer Relations Lead, who reads it first and decides what is said.
V-12 A review that names a colleague, or accuses a colleague of something, is replied to without the colleague's name.
6. How a reply ends
V-13 End every reply with the line: The Rowanmere Market team
